summary: Backend-only testing of App Store reviewer sandbox isolation. Created /app/backend/tests/test_sandbox_isolation.py with 28 tests across 7 areas: reviewer isolation, owner isolation (no sandbox leak), sandbox worker creation propagation, cross-sandbox assignment blocks (task/goal/essential), announcements fan-out & delete guards, worker-side peers/tasks/goals isolation, real-account regression (clock in/out, payroll), and awards guard. All 28/28 tests passed. Reviewer only sees demo worker + demo seed data; owner sees no sandbox data; reviewer-created sandbox workers/tasks stay hidden from owner; reviewer can delete their own sandbox worker but gets 404 deleting real worker; assigning to real worker returns 404 across tasks/goals/essentials; announcements from reviewer only reach demo worker (notification received) and never leak to owner or real worker; peers & time entries properly isolated both directions; real worker clock-in/out flow unaffected; awards user_id spoof properly blocked for reviewer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>2300 lines); consider splitting into routers per resource (workers, tasks, goals, essentials, announcements, time, awards) for maintainability.
Payroll and worker-status responses use nested worker.email while other endpoints expose email at top level — inconsistent shapes; consider standardizing.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral sandbox workers (sbtest+<rand>@loveworks.com) and one sandbox announcement per run; both cleaned up in-test (worker DELETE + announcement DELETE). No real data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sandbox isolation fully verified. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_sandbox_isolation.py as regression. Note nested response shape: /payroll and /admin/worker-status return {worker:{email,...}, ...}. /notifications returns {items:[...], unread:n}. POST /goals and /essentials require query params + multipart (not JSON).
